high_level_description: This image captures the iconic skyline of Florence, Italy, during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the warm hues in the sky transitioning from pink to orange and yellow. The setting is serene and picturesque, with the cityscape stretching out towards the horizon, where rolling hills and mountains provide a dramatic backdrop. The focal point of the image is the majestic Duomo di Firenze (Florence Cathedral), a renowned architectural marvel.
